strategy.summary: Full plunge to the upper flipper, repeat the safer top saucer, use the center safety space and wraparound in Pac-Maze, and chase the lower four-target banks or P-A-C-M-A-N standups only for valuable moves or lives.

quickInfo.name: Six-move start
quickInfo.summary: Complete the upper three-target bank twice to store six moves, then shoot either top saucer.

quickInfo.name: Pac-Maze controls
quickInfo.summary: The left flipper button rotates direction and the right button moves Pac-Man one space.

quickInfo.name: Maze completion
quickInfo.summary: Move Pac-Man through all 25 spaces, including the center after leaving it, to add 250,000 to the final-game bonus.

quickInfo.name: Saucer value
quickInfo.summary: Either top saucer advances the shared value from 1,000 to a 100,000 maximum.

quickInfo.name: Final-game bonus
quickInfo.summary: Each completed maze adds 250,000 and each remaining life adds 50,000 after the final ball.

steps.text: Read the displayed maze time, starting lives, and Extra Ball setting before you plunge.
Use a full plunge past the narrow skill-shot lane and let the ball reach the upper flipper.
Test one upper-bank shot and one top-saucer shot. Watch both returns before you choose the repeatable route.
Repeat the safer top saucer while its return stays controlled.
modeNotes: Saucer value: Either saucer scores the shared value; it starts at 1,000, then reaches 10,000 and rises by 10,000 to 100,000.

steps.text: If Extra Ball lights after the configured fifth or tenth saucer advance, shoot either saucer once more to collect it.
When six moves are stored, shoot a top saucer to start Pac-Maze. Read the remaining move count before the first input.
modeNotes: Pac-Maze: The saucer holds the physical ball while the flipper buttons control Pac-Man on a 5-by-5 grid.

steps.text: Use the left button to rotate direction and the right button to move one space. Each move spends one stored move.
Keep the center safety space available because the ghost cannot enter it. Use edge wraparound to create distance.
During Pac-Man Aggressive, fill safe grid lights before you chase the ghost.
modeNotes: Pac-Man Aggressive: The ghost flees; touching it scores 50,000 and returns it to a random corner.

steps.text: Use the flipper buttons to move Pac-Man through all 25 spaces and complete the maze. Return to the center later because its starting light is not collected automatically.
After the saucer releases the ball, resume the saucer or upper-bank route and protect the final-game bonus.

fallback.title: Upper bank, gate, and saucers
fallback.when: Use this when a direct saucer return is dangerous.

steps.text: Full plunge to the upper flipper.
Complete the upper three-bank for three moves.
Complete it a second time to open the left-outlane gate.
Take a saucer only after its feed is known.
Use the center space and wraparound in Pac-Maze.
Resume upper-bank progress after the ball is released.

alternatives.title: Pac-Maze completion
alternatives.when: Use this when both lower banks return safely and more moves are valuable.

steps.text: Complete each lower four-bank for five moves.
Hit the six lit P-A-C-M-A-N standups; each adds one move.
Complete the word to restore one Pac-Man life.
Shoot a saucer and light all 25 maze spaces.
A completed maze adds 250,000 at game end.

alternatives.title: Precision skill shot
alternatives.when: Use this only after the plunge strength and upper feed are measured.

steps.text: Aim for the narrow upper-right lane into the top-right saucer.
A made plunge gives ten moves and starts Pac-Man Aggressive.
Abandon the shot after a miss or an unsafe upper feed.
Store moves through target banks, lanes, and standups.
Preserve or restore Pac-Man lives.
Enter Pac-Maze with at least six moves.
Complete each 25-space grid.
Store 250,000 for each completed maze and 50,000 for each remaining life.
Avoid tilting the final ball so the completed-maze and remaining-life awards are counted.

techniques.name: Upper-bank return
techniques.instruction: Use the upper flipper for the three top targets. A firm button press can return the ball to that flipper.

techniques.name: Measured saucer skill shot
techniques.instruction: Use a repeatable partial plunge into the top-right saucer for ten moves and Aggressive.

techniques.name: Maze wraparound
techniques.instruction: Move through one grid edge and return from the opposite edge to keep distance from the ghost.

cautions.issue: The top-right skill shot needs a precise partial plunge into the saucer.
cautions.response: Learn the required plunger strength before you depend on its ten Maze moves.

strategy.simpleOverview: Mr. & Mrs. Pac-Man alternates upper-playfield scoring with a button-controlled Pac-Maze. Build six moves at the upper bank, enter through a top saucer, then rotate and move through the grid while preserving the center safety space and edge wraparound. Completed mazes add to the final-game bonus.
strategy.overview: The upper bank in Mr. & Mrs. Pac-Man adds stored maze moves, while playfield switches add maze lives and raise the top-saucer value. Either top saucer starts Pac-Maze. Store at least six moves, light all 25 maze spaces, then return to upper-playfield scoring while protecting completed mazes and remaining lives.
